paraphrase: In a gathering of wanderers the question is raised which of the famous teachers is honoured by his disciples; of Pūraṇa and the others it is said that their disciples do not honour them and leave them, while the Buddha's disciples, even when he is interrupted, fall silent to hear him.
notes: Reported by an opponent: the wanderer Sakuludāyī (MN 77, Buddhist Pali canon). Section refs = SuttaCentral (bilara) segmentation, checked in the local e-text.
